_comment: Quality and infrastructure are INDEPENDENT states, per CTO ruling 31 Aug 2026. A model must not lose the quality ranking because one VPS cannot run it, and must not be promoted because it is cheap.

madlad.infrastructureNote: 21188 MB peak on a 23 GB box that also runs production; Yoruba p95 34.4 s. If human review makes it a route's quality winner, mark QUALITY QUALIFIED / INFRASTRUCTURE BLOCKED and leave optimisation to a separate decision. No quantisation/ONNX/GPU work authorised.

translategemma.note: The licence was never the problem -- Gemma permits commercial hosted use. The model returns Devanagari, Gujarati, Arabic and Thai for yo/ha/ig while translating fr/es/pt AND Swahili correctly in the same run. Regional and script variants (ha-NE, ha-GH, yo-BJ) changed nothing. An instance of Google's own 'experimental tier': present in the chat template, absent in capability.

toucan.note: commercial licence request drafted, not sent by Claude (no email capability). Silence is not permission.
